# **SYSTEM PROMPT & BUILD SPECIFICATION: FLAME FOMO**

## **1\. Product Vision & Architecture**

**FLAME FOMO** is a mobile-first campus discovery and scheduling web application for FLAME University. It centralizes fragmented event information into an actionable, tactile digital planner.

* **Guest Users (Unauthenticated):** Can freely browse the Home page, Explore page, and view detailed event cards.  
  * **FLAME Students (Authenticated):** Must sign in using FLAME University email IDs strictly. Unlocks the ability to create events, save events, manage "My Plan," edit profiles, and use the Campus Map.  
> * **Global Navigation:** Persistent top header containing the FLAME FOMO logo, Home, Explore, My Plan, Campus Map, a Notification Bell (deadline awareness), and the User Profile avatar. *Note: "My Plan" and "Campus Map" require authentication; clicking them as a guest triggers the Sign-In modal.*  
> * **Global Action:** A Floating Action Button (FAB) anchored at the bottom-right for Event Creation. **This is hidden for Guest Users** and only visible after authentication.

## **2\. Tech Stack & Asset Guidelines**

> * **Core Stack:** Next.js (React), Tailwind CSS for styling, and Supabase for the backend database.  
> * **Typography:** Use Google Fonts: 'Playfair Display' (editorial serif for large headings), 'Inter' (clean sans-serif for functional UI data), and 'Caveat' (handwritten accent font strictly for small annotations).  
> * **Assets:** Use placeholder SVGs for scrapbook motifs (tape, polaroids, pins, stamps). Use a static, illustrated paper-textured image for the Campus Map.

## **3\. Visual Identity & UI Design System**

The visual direction is a nostalgic, artsy, and slightly chaotic digital collage.

> * **Guiding Principle:** Decoration can be chaotic, but information cannot. Core text (time, location, action) must be instantly legible on dark, textured, or dotted backgrounds.  
> * **Component Styling:** Use tactile elements like Polaroid frames, paper cards, and torn edges. Apply a subtle rotation (1–3 degrees) to grid items to mimic a physical bulletin board while keeping touch targets accessible.  
> * **Semantic Motif Dictionary:**  
  * **Tape / Pinned Edge:** Attaches event cards to the background.  
  * **Red Deadline Stamp/Box:** Indicates urgent action or registration closing dates.  
  * **Polaroid:** The default container for visual event discovery.  
  * **Yellow Disclaimer Sign:** Used strictly for schedule clash warnings.

## **4\. User Onboarding Flow**

A 4-step modal sequence triggered after successful Google Authentication:

> 1. **Welcome & Sign in/Guest:** Capture basic profile data.  
> 2. **Cohort Identification:** Select Academic Year via buttons (UG1, UG2, UG3, UG4, All).  
> 3. **Interest Mapping:** Toggle category preferences (Academic, Clubs, Sports, Social, Competitions, Workshops, Performances, Career, Talks/Lectures, Other).  
> 4. **Timetable Sync:** A simple grid interface to input current academic class times to enable clash detection.

## **5\. Core Database Models (Conceptual)**

### **5.1. User Profile**

> * flame\_email: Primary key (Strictly @flame.edu.in).  
> * academic\_year: String.  
> * category\_preferences: Array of strings.  
> * academic\_timetable: Array of class objects (Time, Day).  
> * saved\_events: Array of event IDs user has marked "Save" or "I'm Going".

### **5.2. Locations (Strictly Mapped)**

Locations must be categorized into predefined zones based on the official university layout. Event creation dropdowns must pull exclusively from these exact locations:

> * **Academics:** Vikram Sarabhai Centre, APJ Abdul Kalam, Vivekananda Library, Kalidas Centre, Chanakya, Aryabhatta, etc.  
> * **Sports:** Arjuna Centre for Sports, Cricket Ground, Football Ground, Track & Field, Tennis Courts.  
> * **Eateries:** Aahar, Rasoi, Coffee Nation, Hashtag, Blue Tokai Cafe, etc.  
> * **Flora & Fauna:** Butterfly Garden, Nakshatra Garden, Botanical Garden.  
> * **Shantiniketan/Recreational:** Auditorium, FLAME Plaza, FLAME Kund, FLAME Lounge.

## **6\. Screen-by-Screen Build Instructions**

### **6.1. Home Page**

> * **Hero Section:** Editorial heading paired with the current date, a compact search bar, and horizontal quick-filter pills for categories.  
> * **Don't Forget (Priority 1):** A red paper-slip module displaying the single most urgent registration deadline, featuring a direct "Register" CTA button that redirects to the google registration.  
> * **My Plan Today (Priority 2):** A planner-style chronological list of today's committed events and classes.  
> * **Happening Soon (Priority 3):** A horizontally scrollable row of upcoming event Polaroids.  
> * **Your Week:** A compact Monday–Friday preview showing event/class counts per day.

### **6.2. Explore Page**

> * **Function:** The master catalogue. A flexible masonry/collage grid of all upcoming events.  
> * **Filters:** Top-anchored dropdowns for Time (Today, Tomorrow, Custom), Category, and a toggle for "Fits My Schedule".

### **6.3. Profile Page**

> * Contains three distinct tabs:  
  1. **Edit Preferences/Timetable:** Update onboarding inputs.  
  2. **My Saved Events:** Centralized list of bookmarked items.  
  3. **Events I’ve Submitted:** A dashboard to edit or delete UGC events the user has published.

### **6.4. Campus Map**

> * **Logic:** Only events the user has marked as "I'm Going" render as numbered pins on the static map image. Hovering/tapping a pin opens a tooltip with the event name and specific room number.

## **7\. Interaction Logic & Edge Cases**

### **7.1. Event Card States & Interactions**

> * **Default State:** Displays Category, Title, Date, Time, Location, and Deadline.  
> * **Hover/Tap State:** Triggers an overlay containing three interaction buttons:  
  * **Favourite (Star Icon):** Subscribes to similar future notifications.  
  * **I'm Going (Pill):** Adds to "My Plan" and Campus Map.  
  * **Save (Pill):** Bookmarks for later.  
> * **Guest Gatekeeping:** If an unauthenticated user clicks any of the above three buttons, immediately trigger the Sign-In modal (*"Sign in with your FLAME email to save this event and build your plan."*).  
> * **Closed State:** If the current date is past the deadline, the Polaroid transitions to a grayscale/black-and-white filter for users not attending.  
> * **Cancelled State:** Displays a red "Cancelled" visual stamp over the card until the original date passes, after which it is purged from user plans.

### **7.2. Timetable Clash Logic**

> * **Trigger:** An authenticated user clicks "I'm Going", and the event time overlaps with their academic\_timetable or saved\_events.  
> * **Action:** Trigger a non-blocking modal with a yellow disclaimer icon.  
> * **Copy:** *"This clashes with your scheduled event/class."*  
> * **Controls:** Two buttons: **"Continue Anyway"** (forces the add) and **"Nevermind"** (cancels the add).

### **7.3. Empty States ("Free Will" Prompts)**

If a filtered view or "My Plan" returns zero results, render a graphic of an empty scrapbook page. Inject randomized, low-stakes lifestyle prompts (e.g., *"Try a new coffee at your favourite cafe on campus," "Go sit and watch the sunset," "Pick up a new book from the library"*).

## **8\. Event Submission Flow (UGC)**

Triggered by the bottom-right FAB (Authenticated users only). Render a clean form mapping directly to these exact UI treatments:

| Database Field | Required? | UI Treatment / Output |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| event\_name | Yes | Large, prominent title on card |
| category | Yes | Small category label/tag at top of card |
| date | Yes | Prominent typography |
| time\_start\_end | Yes | Prominent typography |
| venue\_zone | Yes | Location line \+ linked to Campus Map logic |
| room\_specific | When known | Appended to location string |
| organizer | Yes | Secondary metadata in expanded view |
| description | Yes | Readable paragraph in expanded view |
| registration\_deadline | When applicable | High-priority red treatment / triggers notification logic |
| registration\_link | When applicable | External CTA button |
| requirements\_eligibility | When applicable | Warning/info block (captures Target Student Year) |
| event\_image | Optional | Visual anchor inside the Polaroid frame |
| status | Yes | Backend toggle: Upcoming / Registration Closed / Cancelled |

*Crucial UX Constraint:* Do not imply that clicking "I'm Going" registers the user. If registration\_link exists, clicking "I'm Going" must simultaneously prompt the user with the external link to complete their actual registration.
